<thought>I need to know how many aromatic carbon atoms are present in the compound. The best way is to retrieve its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
